title: Give the routine the numbers that value a lead
question: Reply with rough figures: average gross profit on a closed for-sale-by-owner acquisition and the qualified-lead-to-deal close rate; the same two for investor-property deals; and whether a renter lead is worth money to you (do you own or manage rentals?).
cost_of_delay: Without these, every funnel ranking is a guess (cren-revenue unit economics items 1-3 and 5).
default_if_unanswered: Park it: the routine treats renter leads as audience-building, ranks funnels only by your stated revenue order, and stops asking for 8 weeks.
